theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), 1 ≤ m → IsOpen D → MeasurableSet F → (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ K → (∀ y, ‖φ y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ y : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) ≤ C) → ∃ (B : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), MeasurableSet B ∧ B ⊆ D ∧ CountablyRectifiable m B ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μHE[m] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) ∧ Measurable ν ∧ (∀ y ∈ B, ‖ν y‖ = 1) ∧ (∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[m].restrict B), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m B y (Submodule.span ℝ {ν y})ᗮ) ∧ ∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ y in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ y : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) = -∫ y in B, inner ℝ (φ y) (ν y) ∂μHE[m]
